sources.revision: Published 2018 LEADER entity table and 2024 general entity-code guidance

observations.count: Group 76 reports the vertex count and is documented as ignored for OPEN.
observations.vertexArrays: Repeated group 10/20/30 values represent X/Y/Z coordinates for each leader vertex.
observations.ordering: Entity group-code order must not be assumed; repeated occurrences preserve their per-component vertex ordinal.

sources.limitation: DXF schema evidence is not DWG layout or native leader rendering evidence.

localAudit.reproducedFailure: The old parser created a point on group 10 and attached groups 20/30 to the current point; Y/Z arrays that preceded X were discarded.
localAudit.correction: Map groups 10/20/30 to vertex slots using independent bounded occurrence ordinals. Preserve the existing 5,000-vertex cap, require the X count to match materialized vertices, retain zero defaults for omitted Y/Z, and leave group 76 advisory.
localAudit.apiCompatibility: No public data field or virtual changed. Private parser counters change the installed class layout, so downstream binaries must rebuild against the updated header/library.
